new_invariants.desc: Pipeline stages execute in constitutional order 1-9; no skip, no reorder
Every stage transition record is HMAC-SHA256 chained to the prior record
CRITICAL risk and INCONCLUSIVE fitness gate on HUMAN-0 ratification
A stage failure immediately aborts the pipeline; no partial promotion
orchestrate() is atomic; a mid-pipeline exception triggers abort ledger entry
Every OrchestrationRecord carries sufficient data for deterministic replay
The final SEAL record is written before orchestrate() returns to any caller
Every stage transition including failures emits a ledger entry
CMO only orchestrates mutations within the ADAAD constitutional scope
Given identical inputs and HMAC key, all stage records are identical
